note.zh: 三行控制条：进度（拖动时浮出目标时间与增量）/ 主控（播放＋±10 秒＋换集，永不折叠）/ 次控（设置·静音·在线字幕·全屏 ＋ 音量）。空格单击显隐、双击左右 ±10 秒、左半竖直调亮度、右半竖直调音量；暂停时中央另有 76dp 大播放键。
note.en: Three-row chrome: scrubber (drag bubble shows target time and delta) / primary row (play, ±10s, prev-next, never folded) / secondary row (settings, mute, online subtitles, fullscreen + volume). Tap toggles chrome, double-tap seeks ±10s, left half swipes brightness, right half volume; a 76dp centre play button appears while paused.
